description.zh:
添加的后端服务器列表，每次调用最多可添加20个后端服务器。

> 后端服务器（ENS实例）必须是运行中才可以加入负载均衡实例。
description.en:
The list of backend servers that you want to add to the Edge Load Balancer (ELB) instance. You can add up to 20 backend servers at a time.

> Only Edge Node Service (ENS) instances that are in the running state can be added to the ELB instance as backend servers.
The IP address of the backend server.

description.zh: 负载均衡实例后端使用的端口。
description.en: The backend port that is used by the ELB instance.
The ID of the ENS instance.

description.zh:
后端服务器类型。取值：
- **ens**：ENS实例。
- **eni**：弹性网卡实例。
description.en:
The type of the backend server. Valid values:

- **ens**: ENS instance

- **eni**: elastic network interface (ENI)

description.zh:
后端服务器的权重。默认值：100，取值：**0**~**100**。

> 取值为0，表示不会将请求转发给该后端服务器。
description.en:
The weight of the backend server. Default value: 100. Valid values: **0** to **100**.

> The value 0 indicates that requests are not forwarded to the backend server.

description.zh: 负载均衡实例前端使用的端口。取值：**1**~**65535**。
description.en: The frontend port that is used by the Edge Load Balance (ELB) instance. Valid values: **1** to **65535**.

descriptions.zh:
- API调用频率：100次/秒。
- 单用户调用频率：10次/秒。
descriptions.en:
- Rate limit: 100 requests per second.

- up to 10 times per second per account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens add-backend-servers --load-balancer-id lb-5qzdmxefgrpxd7oz2mefonvtx --backend-servers Type=ens ServerId=i-5uf6dwyzch3wly7900000 Ip=192.168.XXX Port=3309 Weight=100 --region cn-hangzhou
